name: agent-watch
description: An Agents pane beside the chat, in SIGMAorbital: the Sessions panel (KPI row, status sunburst, selected-element panel and hierarchy table) of this session and its sub-sessions (the task-orchestrator run, Workflow runs, delegating subagents) with their background shells and monitors, with its progress meter also added below Compass's board when Compass is loaded, a toast when an agent fails, and a clickable task-progress meter above the prompt.
